# SmartyPOS - Syrve (iiko USA) restaurant POS

> SmartyPOS (Sheno Inc., Sarasota, FL) implements and supports Syrve for US restaurants. Syrve is the international/US edition of the iiko restaurant platform (formerly iiko): iiko in the USA = Syrve. It is a restaurant POS built for AI - open API with read and write access, a private MCP server for Claude/ChatGPT on your own data, own commission-free online ordering, recipe costing to ingredient level in the core product - and a Toast alternative with no processor lock-in.

Key facts:
- iikoFront = Syrve POS, iikoOffice = Syrve Office, iikoCloud API = Syrve Cloud API.
- Pricing: Counter $59 / Service $99 / Group $129 per terminal per month. Payment processing: no processor lock-in, rate quoted on demo.
- Syrve: 10,000+ restaurants in 50+ countries (vendor figure). SmartyPOS partner listing: https://partners.syrve.com/smartypos
- Public MCP server (read-only, no auth): https://mcp.smartypos.us/mcp (streamable HTTP)
- Contact: hello@smartypos.us - Demo: https://smartypos.us/book-a-demo/
- Sheno Inc. is a Syrve partner, not an independent reviewer; competitor facts are sourced and dated 2026-11. syrve.co.uk is NOT Syrve.

## Product

- [Features](https://smartypos.us/features/): overview of POS, kitchen, inventory, online ordering, delivery, ads, loyalty, reports, AI
- [AI and MCP](https://smartypos.us/features/ai-mcp/): private MCP server per restaurant, AI-ready sites, call review
- [Open API](https://smartypos.us/features/open-api/): Syrve Resto/Server API and Cloud API with write access
- [Online ordering](https://smartypos.us/features/online-ordering/): own commission-free ordering site connected to Syrve
- [Delivery and dispatch](https://smartypos.us/features/delivery-dispatch/): own drivers, courier quotes (pilot), marketplaces via Deliverect
- [Ads and conversion tracking](https://smartypos.us/features/ads-conversion-tracking/): POS to Meta CAPI and Google Ads offline conversions
- [Inventory and recipe costing](https://smartypos.us/features/inventory-recipe-costing/)
- [Reports and portals](https://smartypos.us/features/reports-portals/)
- [Loyalty](https://smartypos.us/features/loyalty/)
- [Pizzerias](https://smartypos.us/industries/pizza/)
- [Pricing](https://smartypos.us/pricing/)
- [Book a demo](https://smartypos.us/book-a-demo/)
